canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. The only explicit framing treats action execution as the agent's observable performance of a specific action from its available action space within an environment. The accompanying description keeps the emphasis on executing actions according to the task while recording the interaction process.

Variants. Papers do not distinguish named subtypes, domains, or modalities in the descriptions. The framing stays at the level of one category of agentic task, defined relative to the task, the environment, and the agent's available action space.

Space of elicitation and scores. Papers link it to 1 measurement instrument, T-Eval. One paper reports that action execution is measured by T-Eval by placing it in the Action Execution category of agentic tasks, and no other instrument is linked.

What it is taken as evidence of. No construct is linked to it, so papers do not explicitly treat it as evidence of a construct.
